name: Helhigan
detailed_description:
Helhigan was built after the final war 1000 years ago between man and machine. You are a famous Golem Battler in the city and was granted a chance at retirement they always wanted. You will have a chance to explore a massive world with endless possibilities. 

 Famous Golem battlers arent the only ones who seek the riches in the ruined world in hopes of upgrading their Golems but Artificers who wish to battle, harvest resources or simply start a new life somewhere if they can. Artificers are powerful mages that are accompanied by Slayers who fight to improve life on Helhigan from outside the city's safety.

 Fear the lost ones, those who fell 1000 years ago and still live in the ruins, they aren't the only enemies but the most abundant, you need to be ready for anything.

Collect Golems and upgrade them, they will help you fight beyond the city of Helhigan too

Hunt and Butcher the wild animals of the world in hopes of regaining more of your humanity and becoming more in touch with the real world and separated from the futuristic world your accustomed too

Fish and seek the rare glowing variety of fish that were blessed by the magic of the world, be careful because they are still creatures from the black sea

Mine or Salvage for materials from ore veins , destroyed machines or whatever other remnants of the war that you can in return alchemize back into Geodes to use with your Golems, Weapons or even Homes

Explore the endless world that is part of the Helhigan world.

Helhigan is a third person loot and shoot with heavy RPG mechanics.

short_description: The world of Helhigan was forever changed by the final war. You are a famous Golem Battler seeking to improve themself beyond the walls, you wont be alone accompanied by Slayers, Artificers and others who seem to survivor outside the world, you won't miss Helhigan thanks to the Touch-Down System.
